can_case_measurement_series_be_rendered_.reason: 22 Measurements link to more than one Case (max 10), so the relation is N:M and a tree must duplicate or drop nodes

can_counts_under_case_cards_be_treated_a.reason: summing measurements under cases counts Case-Measurement incidences (218) rather than unique Measurements (247)

can_experimentalcase_be_labelled_Experim.reason: one case carries up to 6 physical Samples under a single nominal fingerprint, so it is a condition-defined case, not a physical experiment or run

can_measurement_be_presented_as_a_real_o.reason: 247 Measurement entities reduce to 235 distinct acts once represents_same_measurement_as is applied; the remainder are one curve each, so the entity is per-curve, not per-act

can_one_resultseries_be_shown_under_one_.reason: a series reaches its cases through its producer, and a producer with several cases gives the series several cases; picking the first silently hides the rest
